external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A sensor node installed on a customer site that publishes readings and polls for firmware images.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway
external_entities.notes: The nodes are outside the organisation's physical control.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.notes: The source does not identify the technician's organisation or console authentication.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views telemetry dashboards from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker run on GKE that accepts readings from sensor nodes, checks devices, and forwards accepted readings.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer in the analytics network that processes readings and writes them into the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

processes.name: dashboard
processes.description: A dashboard used by fleet operators to view telemetry over BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used to check the node key and determine which customer the node belongs to.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A Pub/Sub service carrying accepted readings to the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing site addresses and occupancy patterns from the sensor fleet.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: Cloud Storage bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket from which sensor nodes poll for firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not state whether firmware images are signed.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.description: Sensor node readings sent to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.description: The device gateway looks up the device to check its key and customer association.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.description: Accepted readings forwarded from the device gateway to Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery
data_flows.data_description: sensor readings, including site addresses and occupancy patterns

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.description: A sensor node polls the Cloud Storage bucket for a firmware image.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image

data_flows.name: service node
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over its local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: The source says: "I don't know what authentication that console has, if any."

data_flows.name: view dashboard
data_flows.description: A fleet operator views a dashboard from the corporate network.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.

data_flows.name: read telemetry
data_flows.description: The dashboard reads telemetry over BigQuery.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake's contents are confidential because it contains site addresses and occupancy patterns that are customer data.
assumptions.basis: The source states: "The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data."

assumptions.assumption: The device registry's stored key is a credential asset.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the registry is used "to check the key"; a pre-shared key is a credential.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake contains personally identifiable information because site addresses are customer data associated with sensor-fleet readings.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns and calls them customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake contains business-critical data because it is the central telemetry lake for the deployed sensor fleet.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the telemetry platform's lake as the destination for accepted fleet readings.

assumptions.assumption: The Cloud Storage bucket's data classification is public because the source explicitly says the bucket is public read.
assumptions.basis: The source states: "The bucket is public read."

assumptions.assumption: The dashboard presents a process interface in the corporate network because the text describes fleet operators looking at dashboards there.
assumptions.basis: The source states that fleet operators look at dashboards from the corporate network.
